links.outcome: Specificity of LLM review in prospective silent cohort on live result streams
links.effect: In the prospective silent cohort (1,435 reference-negative units), specificity was 81.95% (95% CI 79.88%–83.85%). The challenge set correctly classified 705 of 900 real-world negatives and detected 77 of 100 augmented abnormal units.
links.quote: All 1,435 units in the prospective silent cohort were reference-negative, among which NovaMind achieved 81.95% specificity (95% CI, 79.88%–83.85%).

unlisted_practices: Adding longitudinal patient hormone history as model input improved LLM review performance (input ablation)
Patient-based real-time quality control (PBRTQC) as complementary system-level monitoring of result streams
Task-specific two-stage supervised fine-tuning of an LLM for laboratory result plausibility review

screen.reason: The study evaluates a specialized LLM for patient-level laboratory test review, incorporating a prospective silent deployment mode alongside patient-based real-time quality control (PBRTQC) for drift/shift monitoring.

primary.practice: prospective silent evaluation and real-time quality control
